items.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)

sentences.en: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting).
sentences.zh: 自动密钥交换：更快、更后量子安全的原始握手，每天可连接450亿次（并且还在不断增加）。

sentences.en: Every time Cloudflare opens a new TLS 1.3 connection to an origin server, we have to make a guess: the protocol requires us to commit to a key agreement algorithm in the very first packet we send, before the origin has told us anything about itself or what it can support.
sentences.zh: 每次Cloudflare打开与源服务器的新TLS 1.3连接时，我们都必须进行猜测：该协议要求我们在发送的第一个数据包中承诺密钥协商算法，然后源才会告诉我们有关其自身或它可以支持的内容。

sentences.en: If we guess right, the handshake completes in one round trip.
sentences.zh: 如果我们猜对了，握手将在一次往返中完成。

sentences.en: Guess wrong, and the origin replies with a HelloRetryRequest , we start over, and the connection costs two round trips.
sentences.zh: 猜错了，来源回复HelloRetryRequest ，我们重新开始，连接需要两次往返。

sentences.en: For years, our guess was the same for every origin on the Internet: X25519 .
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们对互联网上每个来源的猜测都是一样的： X25519。

sentences.en: Widely supported, but as it turns out, suboptimal for roughly 30% of the origin connections we've since measured.
sentences.zh: 广泛支持，但事实证明，对于我们此后测量的大约30 ％的原始连接来说，这是次优的。

sentences.en: Today we're announcing Automatic Key Exchange , an extension of Automatic SSL/TLS that replaces the guess with a measurement.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布推出自动密钥交换，这是自动SSL/TLS的扩展，用测量代替了猜测。

sentences.en: We probe each origin to learn which key agreement algorithms it supports and prefers, then lead with that algorithm on the first try, preferring the post-quantum hybrid X25519MLKEM768 wherever the origin can speak it.
sentences.zh: 我们探索每个源以了解它支持和偏好的密钥一致性算法，然后在第一次尝试时引导该算法，更喜欢后量子混合X25519MLKEM768 ，无论源可以在哪里说话。

sentences.en: With the ongoing rollout of Automatic Key Exchange across origin connections, HelloRetryRequests fell from roughly 52% to 3.7%, cutting more than 150 ms off connection handshake latency at p90.
sentences.zh: 随着自动密钥交换跨源连接的持续推出， HelloRetryRequests从大约52%下降到3.7% ，在p90上减少了超过150毫秒的连接握手延迟。

sentences.en: In addition, as part of our ongoing rollout, hundreds of thousands of domains now have post-quantum origin connections that nobody had to configure, with that number growing daily.
sentences.zh: 此外，作为我们持续推出的一部分，现在有数十万个域名拥有无需配置的后量子源连接，而且这个数字每天都在增长。

sentences.en: While the milliseconds are important, that second part may matter more.
sentences.zh: 虽然毫秒很重要，但第二部分可能更重要。

sentences.en: Somewhere right now, an adversary is recording encrypted traffic it can't read yet, betting that it will be able to in the future (an attack known as harvest-now, decrypt-later ).
sentences.zh: 现在某个地方，对手正在记录它还无法读取的加密流量，打赌它将来能够这样做（这种攻击被称为harvest-now ， decrypt-later ）。

items.title: Mother flagged faulty smoke alarms before house fire that killed father and five children, court hears

sentences.en: Mother flagged faulty smoke alarms before house fire that killed father and five children, court hears.
sentences.zh: 法庭听说，母亲在房屋起火前举报了有故障的烟雾报警器，导致父亲和五个孩子死亡。

sentences.en: Pre-inquest conference into Queensland deaths hears witnesses did not hear any smoke alarms during 2023 fire Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A landlord was repeatedly warned about improperly installed smoke alarms before a house fire that killed a father and five children in Queensland in 2023, a coroner has heard.
sentences.zh: 昆士兰州调查前死亡会议听说目击者在2023年火灾期间没有听到任何烟雾报警器获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件，免费应用程序或每日新闻播客房东在2023年昆士兰州发生房屋火灾导致一名父亲和五名儿童死亡之前，曾多次被警告烟雾报警器安装不当，验尸官听说。

sentences.en: Deputy state coroner Donald MacKenzie held a pre-inquest conference into the Russell Island deaths on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 州副验尸官唐纳德·麦肯齐（ Donald MacKenzie ）周二就罗素岛（ Russell Island ）的死亡事件举行了预审会议。

items.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people

sentences.en: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击点燃了石油设施，造成73人受伤。

sentences.en: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生在也门胡塞武装和沙特支持的政府部队之间数周不断升级的冲突之后，这场冲突打破了该国内战中为期四年的休战。

items.title: Tokyo tourist hotspot bans short-term rentals amid surge in complaints

sentences.en: Tokyo tourist hotspot bans short-term rentals amid surge in complaints.
sentences.zh: 由于投诉激增，东京旅游热点地区禁止短期出租。

sentences.en: Shinjuku ward targets accommodation in residential areas and near cultural sites as locals complain visitors disposing of rubbish improperly and being too noisy A neighbourhood in Tokyo popular with foreign tourists will ban visitors from using thousands of short-term rental accommodations after a slew of complaints about behaviour.
sentences.zh: 新宿区以住宅区和文化景点附近的住宿为目标，因为当地人抱怨游客处置垃圾不当且太吵。东京的一个受外国游客欢迎的街区将禁止游客使用数千个短期出租住宿。

sentences.en: In the latest sign that Japan’s patience with mass tourism is wearing thin, Shinjuku ward – home to the notorious Kabukicho nightlife district and the world’s busiest railway station – will prevent visitors from using private lodgings in residential areas and near schools and important cultural sites, Japanese media reported this week.
sentences.zh: 日本媒体本周报道，日本对大众旅游的耐心正在减弱的最新迹象是，新宿区--臭名昭著的歌舞伎町夜生活区和世界上最繁忙的火车站的所在地--将阻止游客在住宅区、学校和重要文化景点附近使用私人住宿。

items.title: Canada’s retaliatory US tariffs take effect as trade dispute grows

sentences.en: Canada’s retaliatory US tariffs take effect as trade dispute grows.
sentences.zh: 随着贸易争端的加剧，加拿大对美国的报复性关税生效。

sentences.en: Counter-measures covering several sectors come after Trump announced 50% tariffs on Canadian goods Canada’s retaliatory tariffs on billions of dollars’ worth of American imports have come into effect, escalating a trade fight that has been marked by intensifying tensions between the US president, Donald Trump, and the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普宣布对加拿大商品征收50%的关税后，加拿大对价值数十亿美元的美国进口商品征收报复性关税，这场贸易战升级，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)和加拿大总理马克·卡尼(Mark Carney)之间的紧张关系加剧。

sentences.en: The tariffs took effect at 12.01am on Tuesday, and range from 15% to 50% and apply to products covering $20bn in imports from the US.
sentences.zh: 关税于周二凌晨12点01分生效，从15 ％到50 ％不等，适用于从美国进口价值200亿美元的产品$。

sentences.en: The measures target sectors including steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics – industries that have been most affected by US tariffs.
sentences.zh: 这些措施针对的部门包括钢铁、乳制品、电器、农业设备、纸浆和造纸以及电子产品，这些行业受美国关税影响最大。

sentences.en: Agence France-Presse and Reuters contributed reporting Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 法新社和路透社对本文有报道贡献。继续阅读。

items.title: Hijacking pirates exploit regional chaos to return to seas off Somalia

sentences.en: Hijacking pirates exploit regional chaos to return to seas off Somalia.
sentences.zh: 劫持海盗利用区域混乱重返索马里海域。

sentences.en: US-Israel war on Iran and political instability in Somalia lead to pirates targeting cargo ships off Horn of Africa The scourge of Somali piracy targeting cargo ships and smaller dhows off the Horn of Africa has returned to levels not seen in a decade, driven by a convergence of factors including disruptions to the shipping industry caused by the US-Israeli war against Iran and a resurgence of political instability in Somalia.
sentences.zh: 美国-以色列对伊朗的战争和索马里的政治不稳定导致海盗瞄准非洲之角的货船索马里海盗瞄准非洲之角的货船和小型单桅帆船的祸害已经恢复到十年来从未见过的水平，这是由一系列因素共同推动的，包括美国-以色列对伊朗的战争造成的航运业中断以及索马里政治不稳定的卷土重来。

sentences.en: Since late April there have been eight hijackings by Somali pirates, including two within the space of a fortnight in August : one targeting an oil tanker with ties to Iran, the other a Cameroon-flagged vessel, the Lutuf, carrying military equipment for Turkey.
sentences.zh: 自4月下旬以来，已有8起索马里海盗劫持事件，其中两起发生在8月份的两周内：一起针对与伊朗有联系的油轮，另一起针对为土耳其运送军事装备的悬挂喀麦隆国旗的船只卢图夫号。

items.title: ‘I heard a lot of noise’: trial begins in Mexico for alleged killers of Australian surfers and American friend

sentences.en: ‘I heard a lot of noise’: trial begins in Mexico for alleged killers of Australian surfers and American friend.
sentences.zh: “我听到很多噪音” ：在墨西哥开始审判涉嫌杀害澳大利亚冲浪者和美国朋友的杀手。

sentences.en: Bereaved mother Debra Robinson in court stares at three men accused of murdering Jake and Callum Robinson and Jack Carter Rhoad in 2024 The suspected murderers of two Australian surfers and an American at a Mexican surfing hotspot have gone on trial, two years after the killings in a suspected robbery.
sentences.zh: 失去亲人的母亲黛布拉·罗宾逊（ Debra Robinson ）在法庭上盯着三名被指控在2024年谋杀杰克和卡勒姆·罗宾逊（ Jake and Callum Robinson ）和杰克·卡特·罗德（ Jack Carter Rhoad ）的男子。在涉嫌抢劫的杀人事件发生两年后，两名澳大利亚冲浪者和一名美国人在墨西哥冲浪热点被怀疑谋杀。

sentences.en: Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson, aged 30 and 33 respectively, and their 30-year-old American friend Jack Carter Rhoad were on a surfing trip to Mexico’s Pacific coast when they were shot dead in Baja California state.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚兄弟杰克（ Jake ）和卡勒姆·罗宾逊（ Callum Robinson ） ，分别为30岁和33岁，以及他们30岁的美国朋友杰克·卡特·罗德（ Jack Carter Rhoad ）在下加利福尼亚州被枪杀时，正在墨西哥太平洋沿岸冲浪。
